import uuid
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def init_db(conn) -> None:
    """Create the photos table if it does not exist."""
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, s3_key) -> int:
    """Insert a photo metadata row and return its id."""
    timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, timestamp)
    )
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.lastrowid


def search_photos(conn, term) -> list[dict]:
    """Search photos by title or description, case-insensitively."""
    cursor = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at
        FROM photos
        WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER(?) OR LOWER(description) LIKE LOWER(?)
        ORDER BY id ASC
        """,
        (f"%{term}%", f"%{term}%")
    )
    columns = [desc[0] for desc in cursor.description]
    return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cursor.fetchall()]


def upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type) -> str:
    """Validate and upload a photo, returning its S3 object key."""
    if content_type not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png"):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid content type: {content_type}")
    
    if len(data) > 5 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("File exceeds 5 MiB limit")
    
    # Extract base name and sanitize
    base_name = filename.split("/")[-1]
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", base_name)
    
    # Generate key
    unique_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    key = f"photos/{unique_id}/{safe_name}"
    
    # Upload
    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    
    return key


def photo_url(s3, bucket, key, expires=3600) -> str:
    """Generate a presigned GET URL for a photo."""
    if not (1 <= expires <= 3600):
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    
    return s3.generate_presigned_url(
        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires
    )


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload a photo and save its metadata."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
    
    try:
        photo_id = save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
        raise
    
    return photo_id

MAX_URL_EXPIRY = 3600

def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    """Return the current UTC time as an ISO 8601 string."""
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def _rollback_quietly(conn) -> None:
    try:
        conn.rollback()
    except Exception:
        pass


def init_db(conn) -> None:
    """Create the photos table if it does not already exist."""
    cur = conn.cursor()

            "s3_key TEXT NOT NULL, "

        )

        conn.commit()

    cur = conn.cursor()
    try:
        cur.execute(

            "FROM photos ORDER BY id ASC"
        )

        title = record["title"] or ""
        description = record["description"] or ""
        if needle in str(title).casefold() or needle in str(description).casefold():
            results.append(record)
    return results

        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires,
    )


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload a photo and save its metadata, rolling back the upload on failure."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)

    try:
        return save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
        raise

```yaml AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09' Description: >- Stage 1 (Quadrant A) - Linux web server (Apache httpd with mod_ssl) on a single Amazon EC2 instance in the account's default VPC and default subnet. Parameters: KeyName: Description: Name of an existing EC2 key pair to enable SSH access to the instance. Type: AWS::EC2::KeyPair::KeyName ConstraintDescription: Must be the name of an existing EC2 key pair in this Region. AdminCidr: Description: IPv4 CIDR block of the administrator allowed to connect over SSH (for example 203.0.113.10/32). Type: String MinLength: 9 MaxLength: 18 AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$' ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/n. InstanceType: Description: EC2 instance type for the web server. Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64 Resources: WebServerSecurityGroup: Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup Properties: # No VpcId specified: the security group is created in the default VPC. GroupDescription: Allow inbound HTTPS from anywhere and SSH from the administrator CIDR only. SecurityGroupIngress: - Description: HTTPS from anywhere IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 443 ToPort: 443 CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0 - Description: SSH from administrator CIDR IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 22 ToPort: 22 CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr Tags: - Key: Name Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg' WebServerInstance: Type: AWS::EC2::Instance Properties: # No SubnetId specified: the instance launches in a default subnet of the default VPC, # which assigns a public IPv4 address and public DNS name by default. ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType KeyName: !Ref KeyName SecurityGroupIds: - !GetAtt WebServerSecurityGroup.GroupId UserData: Fn::Base64: !Sub | #!/bin/bash set -euxo pipefail # Install Apache HTTP Server and mod_ssl dnf install -y httpd mod_ssl # Ensure a self-signed certificate exists for mod_ssl's default configuration if [ ! -f /etc/pki/tls/certs/localhost.crt ] || [ ! -f /etc/pki/tls/private/localhost.key ]; then openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -days 365 \ -keyout /etc/pki/tls/private/localhost.key \ -out /etc/pki/tls/certs/localhost.crt \ -subj "/CN=$(hostname -f)" chmod 600 /etc/pki/tls/private/localhost.key fi # Write the index page cat > /var/www/html/index.html <<'EOF' Stage 1 Web Server

Hello from Amazon Linux 2023

This page is served over HTTPS by Apache httpd with mod_ssl.

Stack: ${AWS::StackName} | Region: ${AWS::Region}

EOF # Start httpd now and enable it at boot systemctl enable --now httpd Tags: - Key: Name Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-server' Outputs: InstanceId: Description: ID of the web server EC2 instance. ```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Photo-sharing website - custom VPC with public web tier, private database tier
  (RDS MySQL), reusable launch template and a web server with an Elastic IP.

Parameters:
  CustomAmiId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: ID of the custom AMI created in the labs (must exist in this Region)
  AdminCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: Administrators' network (CIDR) allowed to connect via SSH, e.g. 203.0.113.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range such as 203.0.113.0/24
  DBMasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: dbadmin
    Description: Master username for the MySQL database
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,15}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter; letters, digits and underscores only (max 16)
  DBName:
    Type: String
    Default: photos
    Description: Name of the initial database
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,63}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter; letters, digits and underscores only

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Network
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  GatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: GatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private route table: local VPC route only, deliberately no internet route
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # -------------------------------------------------------- Security groups
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web server - HTTP/HTTPS from anywhere, SSH from administrators
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg'

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Database - MySQL only from the web server security group
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-sg'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------- Web server
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: |
            #!/bin/bash -xe
            (yum install -y httpd php php-mysqlnd || \
              dnf install -y httpd php8.2 php8.2-mysqlnd || \
              dnf install -y httpd php8.1 php8.1-mysqlnd)
            systemctl enable httpd
            systemctl start httpd

  WebServer:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn: PublicDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber

  WebElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: GatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-eip'

  WebElasticIPAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIPAssociation
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt WebElasticIP.AllocationId
      InstanceId: !Ref WebServer

  # --------------------------------------------------------------- Database
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-sharing database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance

        - Key: Name
          Value: WebServerEIP

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

        - Key: Name

    DeletionPolicy: Delete

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

        - Key: Name

    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance

    Properties:

      AllocatedStorage: "20"
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true

      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup

        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup

      MultiAZ: false

      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      DeletionProtection: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db"

Outputs:

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Photo-sharing website stage 2 - custom VPC, web server from launch template with Elastic IP, and private RDS MySQL database

Parameters:
  AmiId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: Custom AMI ID for the web server (must exist in the deployment Region)
  AdminCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR range allowed to connect with SSH (TCP 22), for example 203.0.113.10/32
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(\d|[1-2]\d|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range such as 203.0.113.10/32
  DBMasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: admin
    Description: Master user name for the MySQL database (the password is generated and managed by RDS in Secrets Manager)
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 16
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters or underscores

Resources:
  # ---------------- Networking ----------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------- Security groups ----------------
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web server security group - HTTP/HTTPS from anywhere, SSH from admin CIDR only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg'

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Database security group - MySQL from web security group only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-sg'

  # ---------------- Web tier ----------------
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref AmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !GetAtt WebSecurityGroup.GroupId
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: |
            #!/bin/bash
            if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              dnf install -y httpd php php-mysqlnd
            else
              yum install -y httpd php php-mysqlnd || yum install -y httpd php php-mysql
            fi
            systemctl enable httpd
            systemctl start httpd

  WebServerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'

  WebServerEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-eip'

  WebServerEIPAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIPAssociation
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt WebServerEIP.AllocationId
      InstanceId: !Ref WebServerInstance

  # ---------------- Database tier ----------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the MySQL database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-group'

  Database:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt PhotoBucket.Arn

  WebServerInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebServerRole

  # RDS Database
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS MySQL database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  DBPassword:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Description: Master password for RDS MySQL database
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: !Sub '{"username": "${DBMasterUsername}"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'

  RDSInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: 8.0.35
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      MasterUserPassword: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${DBPassword}:SecretString:password}}'
      DBName: !Ref DBName
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      PreferredBackupWindow: 03:00-04:00
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: mon:04:00-mon:05:00
      PubliclyAccessible: false

  # Application Load Balancer
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ALB'

  ALBTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3

  ALBListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref ALBTargetGroup

  # Launch Template
  WebServerLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref WebServerAMI
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebServerInstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebServerSecurityGroup
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: !Sub |
            #!/bin/bash
            echo "S3_BUCKET=${PhotoBucket}" >> /etc/environment
            echo "DB_HOST=${RDSInstance.Endpoint.Address}" >> /etc/environment
            echo "DB_NAME=${DBName}" >> /etc/environment
            echo "DB_USER=${DBMasterUsername}" >> /etc/environment
            echo "DB_PASSWORD=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id ${DBPassword} --query SecretString --output text --region ${AWS::Region} | jq -r .password)" >> /etc/environment

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebServerAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebServerLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebServerLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref ALBTargetGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebServer'
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  # Auto Scaling Policies
  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebServerAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # CloudFront Distribution
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - Id: ALBOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: ALBOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - Host
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
  
  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: Application Load Balancer DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-2"

  PrivateSubnet1:

        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-sg"

    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:

    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Launch template and Auto Scaling group (R7, R8, R9)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref ImageId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0

        IamInstanceProfile:

          - ResourceType: instance

              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"

  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    DependsOn: PrivateDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: "2"
      MaxSize: "4"
      DesiredCapacity: "2"
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:

      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70
        DisableScaleIn: false

  # RDS MySQL (R12, R13)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup

      StorageEncrypted: true

      PubliclyAccessible: false
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      DeletionProtection: false
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront distribution (R14)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} photo-sharing front end"
        Origins:
          - Id: AlbOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:

        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: AlbOrigin

            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET

          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3

  # Launch Template
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub 'web-lt-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        AssociatePublicIpAddress: false

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub 'asg-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300

  # Target Tracking Scaling Policy
  CPUScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # RDS DB Subnet Group
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub 'db-subnet-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # RDS MySQL Instance
  MySQLDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'mysql-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MasterUsername: admin
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref DatabaseMasterPassword
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      PreferredBackupWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: 'sun:04:00-sun:05:00'

  # CloudFront Distribution
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - '*'
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 0
          MaxTTL: 0

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Stage 3 photo-sharing website: highly available, multi-AZ VPC with an internet-facing
  ALB, Auto Scaling web tier in private subnets, NAT egress, S3 photo bucket, Multi-AZ
  RDS MySQL, and a CloudFront distribution in front of the load balancer.

Parameters:
  AmiId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: Custom AMI ID for the web instances

  DBMasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: dbadmin
    Description: Master username for the RDS instance (password is managed by Secrets Manager)
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,15}"
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a letter and contain only alphanumerics (max 16 characters)

Resources:

  ############################################################
  # Networking
  ############################################################

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-2"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-2"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip"

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat"

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ############################################################
  # Security groups
  ############################################################

  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow inbound HTTP from anywhere to the load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg"

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow inbound HTTP only from the load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-sg"

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow inbound MySQL only from the web instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-sg"

  ############################################################
  # Application Load Balancer
  ############################################################

  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb"

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-tg"

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  ############################################################
  # S3 photo bucket
  ############################################################

  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-photos"

  ############################################################
  # IAM for web instances
  ############################################################

  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PhotoBucketObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub "${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*"

  WebInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  ############################################################
  # Launch template and Auto Scaling
  ############################################################

  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref AmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"

  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: "2"
      MaxSize: "4"
      DesiredCapacity: "2"
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  WebCpuScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70
        DisableScaleIn: false

  ############################################################
  # RDS MySQL (Multi-AZ, encrypted, private)
  ############################################################

  DatabaseSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-sharing database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-subnets"

  PhotoDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: "20"
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DatabaseSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db"

  ############################################################
  # CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB
  ############################################################

  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} photo-sharing distribution"
        Origins:
          - Id: AlbOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: AlbOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - PATCH
            - POST
            - DELETE
          Compress: true
          # Managed "CachingDisabled" policy and "AllViewer" origin request policy
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: Domain name of the CloudFront distribution
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDnsName:
    Description: DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Stage 3 (Quadrant C) - Secure, scalable, highly available photo-sharing website.
  VPC with public/private subnets across two AZs, NAT gateway, internet-facing ALB,

Parameters:
  WebAmiId:

  DBMasterUsername:
    Type: String

    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 16

  DBName:

    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters.
    Description: Initial database name.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

        - Key: Name

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

    Properties:

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:

    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId

        - Key: Name

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP from anywhere to the Application Load Balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP from anywhere

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg'

  WebSecurityGroup:

      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTP from the load balancer only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg'

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow MySQL only from the web instance security group
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
          Description: MySQL from web instances only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-sg'

  # S3 photo bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PhotoBucket:

      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-photos'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role and instance profile for web instances
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PhotoBucketObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'

  WebInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Load balancer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb'

  WebTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: '200'
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tg'

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:

      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref WebTargetGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Compute: launch template, Auto Scaling group, scaling policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref WebAmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGatewayEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-natgw'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ##########################################################################
  # Security Groups
  ##########################################################################

  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow inbound HTTP from the internet to the ALB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  WebServerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP only from the load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow MySQL only from the web servers
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebServerSecurityGroup
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  ##########################################################################
  # S3 bucket for photos
  ##########################################################################

  PhotosBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  ##########################################################################
  # IAM role / instance profile for EC2
  ##########################################################################

  WebServerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PhotosBucketObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotosBucket.Arn}/*'

  WebServerInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebServerRole

  ##########################################################################
  # Load Balancer
  ##########################################################################

  LoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Type: application
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3

  Listener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref LoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  ##########################################################################
  # Launch Template / Auto Scaling Group
  ##########################################################################

  WebServerLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref AmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebServerInstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false
            Groups:
              - !Ref WebServerSecurityGroup

  AutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebServerLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebServerLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: '2'
      MaxSize: '4'
      DesiredCapacity: '2'
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 120
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  CpuTargetTrackingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref AutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70

  ##########################################################################
  # RDS MySQL
  ##########################################################################

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS using private subnets
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      DBName: !Ref DBName
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup

  ##########################################################################
  # CloudFront
  ##########################################################################

  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - Id: ALBOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: ALBOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: Domain name of the CloudFront distribution
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.DNSName
```
